decisions.reason: The same source message's shower-location change is already fully represented by the candidate's existing MODIFY; the drain-location change belongs to the source Requirement.
The source changes Unit 3 corridor, shower, and drain placement and does not change open-plan kitchen cabinetry.
The same source message's 10 cm wall movement for narrowing the corridor is already fully represented by the candidate's existing MODIFY.
The wall movement is specifically the corridor-narrowing method already owned by REQ_COMMON_CORRIDOR_LAYOUT; duplicating it under the broader partition Requirement would create an umbrella copy.
